Now that you have the money, you can purchase the Corvette that will be used in this stage of training. First, however, it is advisable that you sell all your current upgrades. When ships are sold, the upgrades that are on the previous ship are not transferred to the next. Before visiting the shipyard, go to "Outfit Ship" and sell as much as you can. Then, select "Visit Shipyard" and purchase a Corvette. Return to the Spaceport Bar when you have purchased the ship.
